simple.meaning: סִבֹּלֶת (çibbôleth) is a Hebrew word meaning “an ear of grain.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סִבֹּלֶת (H5451) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in סִבֹּלֶת (H5451) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: סִבֹּלֶת (çibbôleth) / H5451 is traced through Judges 12:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H5451. sibboleth סִבֹּ֫לֶת noun feminine probably ear of wheat , etc., only Judg 12:6 dialect form of II. שִׁבֹּלֶת q. v. (> = late word שִׁבֹּ֫לֶת tide, flood ); compare Marquardt ZAW viii (1888), 151 ff. but also GFM Bu.
